Winner restores the shape span 'elliptiques-oblongs' pending a leaflet-lamina bearer; loser asserts 'face supérieure pubescente' (pubescent on the leaflet adaxial epidermis, bearer_scope FLOPO_0986002); different span and quality, correct bearer (folioles ... limbes ... face supérieure), no contradiction.

Loser bears 'longues de 10-15 cm' on the leaflet (PO_0020049; 'pennes' = pinnae, PO narrow synonym of leaflet), which is the correct bearer; the winner removed the wrong leaf-lamina bearer and left this span pending exactly such a bearer, so the loser completes the correction (2-of-3 machine review).

'lobes up to 1.5 mm long' is length of the lobes (leaf lamina lobe PO_0025517), a correct bearer; the winner removed the wrong leaf-lamina length and left the span pending a bearer; the loser supplies it (2-of-3 machine review).

Loser asserts brown (colour, no further review needed) on the lamina adaxial epidermis for 'brun rouille foncé ... dessus' (scope 'dessus'), the surface-restricted form the winner's correction asked for; the winner's other restored span '± coriace' is not touched by the loser and stays unresolved.

Loser asserts 'face supérieure glabre' on the lamina adaxial epidermis (explicit scope text), correct bearer and quality; the winner's restored span is 'vert' (green, above), not touched by the loser and stays unresolved.
